title: Large Sidon Subsets and Pair-Sum Multiplicities of Distinct Multinomial Coefficients
summary: For a positive integer $n$, let $\mathcal{M}_n$ be the set of distinct multinomial coefficient values $n!/(p_1!\cdots p_t!)$, where $(p_1,\ldots,p_t)$ ranges over the integer partitions of $n$. We study two complementary aspects of the additive structure of $\mathcal{M}_n$: the maximum cardinality $s(n)$ of a Sidon subset and the multiplicities of unordered pair sums in the full set.
